'''Howard Busch''' was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 21) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at Fort Lauderdale, FL on the 23 April 2003 roster.<ref name="vol20030423">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423194826/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 23 April 2003)</ref> With [[Mitch Velasco]] and [[Chris Coffee]] he brought the MegaCon Open Qualifier, the first SWCCG Open Qualifier of 2003, to the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando on 1 March 2003.<ref name="pc-champ0206">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He was tournament director of the [[2003 Florida State Championship]] at Sci-Fi City, Orlando, on 7 June 2003.<ref name="pc-us03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> In November 2003 Tournament Advocate [[Mitch Velasco]] described him as a Squadron Representative for the Miami area.<ref name="pcf-1998-35471">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=35471#35471 Hullo], Mitch Velasco, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040115053330/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1998%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
